checks.label: Main menu starts by mouse
Lottery starts locked
Actual TobaccOS click buys lottery development once
Consignment order waits for delivery without charging face value
Consignment arrives as selectable ticket stock
Actual E picks one unpaid scratch ticket from its rack
Actual barcode handover prepares payment but does not activate the ticket
Actual F opens existing cash register for lottery sale
Actual cash approval activates one ticket and updates the shared till
Only commission is spendable, operator stake remains reserved
Repeated cash approval cannot sell the paper twice
Actual door interaction closes the lottery day
Enter starts next day with lottery state intact
Development, paid paper and reserve survive day transition
Original NPC brings back the exact paid paper
Actual E opens physical lottery terminal
Terminal scans the actual paid winning paper
Actual prize confirmation pays once from the shared physical till
Prize payout creates correct operator receivable
Actual settlement credits operator reimbursement without a second sale
Escape restores normal world input after lottery terminal
Duplicate typed numbers cannot print or consume a blank
Actual typed customer numbers print one physical number ticket
Number ticket uses the existing physical bank card terminal
Wrong card amount cannot activate number ticket
Correct card approval activates number ticket with exact commission and reserve
Actual door interaction closes the lottery day
Enter starts next day with lottery state intact
Next game day resolves one five-number draw
